description: One foreground await Nanobot.run call on an existing instance, including returned and raised exits.
no_overrun_rule: Observation of this call stops at Nanobot.run returns RunResult, raises an exception, or propagates asyncio.CancelledError. Separate background consolidation, detached spawned tasks (spawn(wait=false)), future cron jobs and detached processes are not awaited by this boundary and may continue; external channel acknowledgement and global quiescence are excluded. Awaited spawn(wait=true) work remains inside the foreground call.
stop_node: Nanobot.run returns RunResult, raises an exception, or propagates asyncio.CancelledError
terminal_condition: The call Nanobot.run returns RunResult, raises an exception, or propagates asyncio.CancelledError. A return or raised exit ends this foreground boundary, not business acceptance.
